description: P29.6 microsomal-binding (fu_mic) and blood:plasma-ratio (Rb) inputs for the P29.2 well-stirred IVIVE clearance arm. logP is ChEMBL_37 ALogP (per-drug CHEMBL id). pKa / ionisation class fixes the lipophilicity descriptor (Austin/Hallifax-Houston use logP for bases and logD7.4 for neutrals/acids; none of these drugs is an anionic acid at pH 7.4, and every neutral here lacks an ionisable group at 7.4 so logD7.4 == ALogP) and the Rb acid/base default. Rb is a measured human whole-blood:plasma ratio where a primary source reports one directly, else the base/neutral default. Numbers are literature-sourced; none is invented. See docs/p29-6-fu-mic-rb.md.

fu_mic.equation: fu_mic = 1 / (1 + C * 10^(0.072*x^2 + 0.067*x - 1.126)), x = logP for bases and logD7.4 for neutrals/acids, C = microsomal protein concentration in mg/mL
fu_mic.equation_source: Hallifax & Houston 2006 (quadratic refinement of the Austin et al. 2002 logP microsomal-binding model); PMIDs 16552024 (Hallifax-Houston 2006) and 12433825 (Austin et al. 2002)
fu_mic.equation_pmid_note: Method citations, not drug records. 16552024 = Hallifax & Houston 2006 DMD, the quadratic fu_mic coefficients used here; 12433825 = Austin et al. 2002 DMD, the original logP-based microsomal-binding model it refines. Neither names a single benchmark drug.
fu_mic.protein_basis: declared default: the ChEMBL CLint records carry no per-assay microsomal protein concentration, so a default is declared. 0.5 mg/mL is the standard human-liver-microsome substrate-depletion CLint assay concentration.
fu_mic.protein_source: Sloczynska et al. 2019, Acta Pharm 69:345-361, PMID 31259741 (review stating the standard HLM metabolic-stability/CLint incubation at 0.5 mg/mL microsomal protein)
fu_mic.protein_pmid_note: Method/assay-convention citation, not a drug record; it states the standard HLM CLint incubation protein concentration and names no single benchmark drug.

rb_defaults.source: Obach 1999 acid/base convention (bases and neutrals Rb=1, acids Rb~0.55), PMID 10534321
rb_defaults.pmid_note: Method/convention citation (well-stirred IVIVE with blood and microsome binding), not a drug record; names no single benchmark drug.

haloperidol.rb_source: Cheng et al. 1987, Psychopharmacology (Berl) 91:410-414, PMID 3108922 (steady-state blood:plasma concentration ratio 0.79+/-0.03 in psychotic patients)

desipramine.rb_source: searched-and-empty: only an in-vitro RBC/plasma ratio (~0.78) is public, not a whole-blood:plasma Rb; base default (see rb_defaults)

chlorpromazine.rb_source: searched-and-empty: erythrocyte/plasma ~0.5 reported (Lund 1980) but no direct whole-blood:plasma Rb (conversion needs an assumed haematocrit); base default (see rb_defaults)

maprotiline.rb_source: searched-and-empty: reported to concentrate in erythrocytes (Maguire 1980, Clin Chem 26:1624) but no numeric whole-blood:plasma Rb; base default (see rb_defaults)

mirtazapine.rb_source: searched-and-empty: only a postmortem blood:plasma ratio (~2.5) is public, not an antemortem Rb; base default (see rb_defaults)

clozapine.rb_source: Flanagan et al. 2003, Br J Clin Pharmacol 56:135, PMID 12848787 (whole-blood clozapine ~10% below plasma, i.e. Rb ~0.88-0.90)

risperidone.rb_source: Mannens et al. 1994, Psychopharmacology (Berl), PMID 7531854 (blood:plasma concentration ratio averaged 0.67 in man)

promazine.rb_source: searched-and-empty: no public human whole-blood:plasma ratio found; base default (see rb_defaults)

chlordiazepoxide.rb_source: searched-and-empty: no public human whole-blood:plasma ratio found; neutral default (see rb_defaults)

lorazepam.rb_source: searched-and-empty: no public human whole-blood:plasma ratio found; neutral default (see rb_defaults)

oxazepam.rb_source: searched-and-empty: no public human whole-blood:plasma ratio found; neutral default (see rb_defaults)

trimipramine.rb_source: searched-and-empty: no public human whole-blood:plasma ratio found; base default (see rb_defaults)

clomipramine.rb_source: searched-and-empty: plasma/whole-blood 0.70-1.20 reported (PMID 1277478), spanning 1 with no single value; base default (see rb_defaults)

trazodone.rb_source: searched-and-empty: no public human whole-blood:plasma ratio found; base default (see rb_defaults)

citalopram.rb_source: searched-and-empty: RBC accumulation reported in vitro (Fisar et al. 2006, PMID 16816836) but no clean in-vivo whole-blood:plasma Rb; base default (see rb_defaults)
citalopram.rb_pmid_note: PMID 16816836 ('Distribution of antidepressants between plasma and red blood cells') names citalopram in its abstract/MeSH, not its title; it is cited here only as the in-vitro RBC-distribution source that was NOT adopted.

alprazolam.pka_source: PubChem CID 2118: triazolo-1,4-benzodiazepine, no ionisable group with pKa near 7.4, so neutral at physiological pH
alprazolam.rb_source: searched-and-empty: no public human whole-blood:plasma ratio found; neutral default (see rb_defaults)

diazepam.rb_source: searched-and-empty: benzodiazepines are reported to be excluded from erythrocytes (Rb<1) but no single vetted primary whole-blood:plasma value is adopted here; neutral default (see rb_defaults)

fluphenazine.rb_source: searched-and-empty: no public human whole-blood:plasma ratio found; base default (see rb_defaults)

imipramine.rb_source: searched-and-empty: only an in-vitro RBC/plasma ratio (~0.64) is public (PMID 3982232), not a whole-blood:plasma Rb; base default (see rb_defaults)
imipramine.rb_pmid_note: PMID 3982232 ('Uptake and/or binding of tricyclic antidepressants in human red cells') names imipramine in its abstract/MeSH, not its title; it is cited here only as the source of the RBC/plasma ratio that was NOT adopted.

nomifensine.pka_source: PubChem CID 4528: tetrahydroisoquinoline primary/secondary amine, basic at physiological pH
nomifensine.rb_source: searched-and-empty: no public human whole-blood:plasma ratio found; base default (see rb_defaults)

venlafaxine.rb_source: searched-and-empty: no public human whole-blood:plasma ratio found; base default (see rb_defaults)
